title: Giving With Eternity In Mind
description: Join Pastor Chris Zehner as he shares updates from The River Church of Kansas City, from the upcoming Toy Fest and River Casey Family Christmas Dinner to the exciting plans for the church's Christmas programs and services. In this sermon, Pastor Chris also shares a powerful message on the importance of giving and trusting God with your resources, encouraging listeners to respond with obedience and faith. Don't miss this inspiring and practical message from Pastor Chris Zehner!
